identity_reassertion.note: Every RED row re-asserted its identifier on the fetched page.

zero_is_a_fault.note: IN returned zero listings with no archived empty-result page to corroborate it. Zero is not published as a finding without an affirmative negative.

join_key_coverage.note: Tracked separately from row count. An arm can return thousands of clean rows that match nothing, and a row-count check passes it happily.

sibling_differential.note: No arm has collapsed against its siblings across two sweeps.

implausible_cleanliness.note: No prior sweep to compare against.

currency_fingerprint.note: Every DE row must carry EUR, every IN row INR, every US row USD. Kills a country-drift failure class that cross-arm comparison is blind to.

schema_drift.note: Every field the collectors returned is mapped by the contract.

freshness.note: Rows older than the freshness bound are historical. DAY counters freeze at last capture rather than continuing to count.
